No outbound export row with destination country, HS code and B/L number was visible in the free view. Source counter: page claims 35,349 shipments / 31 trading partners / 43 ports; rows actually seen = 5 (all inbound, all same B/L 1067922, all HS 84483290).

Company website kirloskartoyota.com did not resolve (DNS error) and web_search was unavailable during this session, so no domestic supply record could be checked. note: HS discrepancy: declared 844590 vs actual records 84483290 (parts of textile ring-spinning frames) — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; actual code should be corrected to 84483290. Industry claim "Металлургия и горнодобыча" is inconsistent with the observed product line (textile machinery parts, JV with Toyota Industries) — flag for correction, not rejection. Evidence of real trade activity exists (35k+ customs records, latest 2026-02-27), but the free view only exposes inbound Japan→India lines; outbound export shipments are therefore 'declared_only' pending a paid export-data view (volza/eximpedia returned HTTP 403).
